source_classes.provider: nflverse/nflverse-data with upstream PFR courtesy caveat

cutoff_policy.historical_fake_preseason: predictors must be known before frozen target-season cutoff; target-season Week 1+ data prohibited
cutoff_policy.mutable_metadata: requires an as-of snapshot or exclusion
cutoff_policy.post_cutoff_generated_asset: allowed only for fields proven fixed and cutoff-safe

custody_policy.minimum_retention: model life plus seven years after retirement
custody_policy.integrity_check: quarterly and immediately before every audit or rerun
custody_policy.rights_limited_rule: derived evidence is admissible only with a lawful independently accessible reference; hashes alone are insufficient

stable_row_key.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON array with no whitespace

full_row_evidence.coverage: every considered player-season including zero-game and excluded rows
preprocessing_and_model_fields: complete ordered training keys and digest
full_row_evidence.outcome_join: targets live in a separate access-controlled table joined only after the pre-score prediction lock

serializer.fallback: versioned ordered typed-array encoding with explicit nulls and lossless decimal or UTF-8 strings

fail_closed_conditions: missing duplicate extra or reordered cohort keys
source schema feature preprocessing model environment or code digest mismatch
prediction lacking feature preprocessing or model lineage
evaluation row lacking a pre-score prediction row
missing retained bytes or independently auditable rights-compatible reference
new bytes substituted at a locked mutable URL
future_reproducibility_lock_must_bind: this contract ID version and hash
audited source-snapshot manifest and retained-object verification
cohort rules manifest and ordered keys
feature schema definitions transforms and serializer
candidate models hyperparameters and selection gates
dependency runtime OS architecture locale timezone and numeric libraries
repository code SHA and clean-tree assertion
required_chronology: model-protocol freeze before fitting or scoring

reuse_disposition.WR-033: re-version documented candidate ideas only; no input fitted-state prediction or replay identity
reuse_disposition.WR-034: may remain separately versioned availability_v1_wr034 only when exact accepted artifacts and hashes are bound; refit is new
reuse_disposition.WR-029: reuse governance principles only; no inherited source or model identity
reuse_disposition.WR-025: research lineage and candidate rationale only; no full-cohort keyed identity
reuse_disposition.WR-035_WR-037: historical failure-mode evidence only; no accepted Phase-5 or v2 authority

authorization_after_wr040_pass: Manager decision on a no-scoring source-custody checkpoint only
self_hash_rule: adjacent sidecar contains SHA-256 of these exact UTF-8 JSON file bytes followed by two spaces, basename, and LF
